title: Flag tape in a loop frame
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. In a configuration with $B.k+1+(1+F.k)+1$ work tapes, form a new configuration by placing the flag tape on tape $B.k$ with head at position $0$, the counter tape on tape $B.k+1$ with head at position $ch$, and the payload tape on tape $B.k+1+(1+F.k)$ with head at position $ph$, while retaining the base configuration's other tapes; use the specified state, input-head position, and output word. The symbol scanned by tape $B.k$ in this new configuration is the flag tape's content at position $0$.
